label: Water Rover v2 - Central Dashboard (Issue #12)
info:
Central SCADA for the Water Rover v2. Every subsystem team has its own dashboard tab.
Topic map: docs/TOPICS.md. Works with the ESP32 firmware or with the Gazebo sim (ros2 launch waterdroid_bringup simulation.launch.py mqtt:=true).

name: E-stop badge
State readout
State id (0 idle . 1 river . 2 intake/dose . 3 homestead . 4 deliver . 5 e-stop)
label: State id (0 idle . 1 river . 2 intake/dose . 3 homestead . 4 deliver . 5 e-stop)

name: Telemetry -> CSV line
Last frame
Log file: ~/.node-red/rover_mission_log.csv
info: One CSV row per telemetry frame (1 Hz).

name: Intake status
Filtration status
func:
const d = msg.payload || {};
return [{payload: d.s1}, {payload: d.s2}, {payload: d.s3}, {payload: d}];

name: Transfer status
func:
const s = msg.payload || {};
return [{payload: `${s.pump ? 'PUMPING' : 'idle'} . column ${Number(s.column_ml||0).toFixed(0)} mL . moved ${Number(s.total_ml||0).toFixed(0)} mL total`}];

name: Build dose command
func:
msg.payload = JSON.stringify({pump: 'chlorine', ml: flow.get('chlorine_ml') ?? 1.1});
return msg;

name: Dosing totals
Intake angle (0 raised - 90 in the water)
label: Intake angle (0 raised - 90 in the water)

name: ANGLE:n
Arm status
func:
const s = msg.payload || {};
return [{payload: Number(s.angle||0)}, {payload: s.deployed ? 'IN THE WATER' : (s.stowed ? 'RAISED (safe to drive)' : (s.moving ? 'MOVING' : 'HOLD'))}];

name: Delivery status
func:
const s = msg.payload || {};
return [{payload: Number(s.clean_ml||0)}, {payload: `${s.deliveries||0} deliveries . ${Number(s.delivered_total_ml||0).toFixed(0)} mL total . ${s.state || (s.pump ? 'PUMPING' : 'idle')}${s.reason ? ' (' + s.reason + ')' : ''}`}];

name: Fixed nozzle: park the container under it
info: The servo moves the intake, not the outlet. The intake pump only runs with the intake lowered; the rover only drives with it raised.

name: Each press moves ~0.6 s (dead-man)
info: Drive is refused while pumps run or during a mission leg - pause the mission first.

name: Drive status
Calibrate: measure metres / 5 and degrees / 5
info: Put NAV_SPEED_MPS and NAV_TURN_DPS in waterdroid_esp32.ino. Re-calibrate on the real ground and after charging the power bank. "Arrived" buttons on the Mission tab also re-sync the estimated position.

name: Route status
Village map
format:
x {{msg.payload.x}} m . y {{msg.payload.y}} m . target {{msg.payload.target || "-"}}   river . offload bays . depot (0,0)
Dashed line = fixed route. On the rover the position is an ESTIMATE (dead reckoning, no GPS yet) - press the Mission tab "Arrived" buttons to re-sync it at a stop.
